assumptions: Synthetic energy demonstration; hand-authored hourly mean power, not observed meter or benchmark data.
Fixed UTC hourly buckets use right endpoints; available_at equals event_time by synthetic assumption, with no local-time or DST conversion.
Values measure mean power in kW, not energy in kWh; no meter integration or missing-minute validation was performed.
The three-hour repetition period is illustrative; no daily, weather or demand-response relationship has been established.
Point-only seasonal baseline; no calibrated intervals, joint paths, capacity-exceedance probabilities or causal claims.
